svg.title: How the LLM hallucination detector turns token logprobs into a confidence heatmap
svg.desc: Each token of a real Llama 3.1 answer gets p = e^logprob and a colour from red to grey. Tokens join into words; a word with a token below the 0.6 threshold is flagged. Aelbert (p 0.49) and Dordrecht (p 0.57) are flagged, with the alternatives the model weighed: The 0.43 and üsseldorf 0.39.
svg.text: How an answer becomes a confidence heatmap
A real Llama 3.1 8B answer (examples/logprobs/cuyp.json), run with --threshold 0.6
Every token comes with a logprob. p = e^logprob, then colour by p
filled dot = token with letters or digits, hollow = punctuation or space (never flags). Below the line: "A" 0.49, "ord" 0.57
Tokens join into words. A word is flagged if any of its tokens is below 0.6
Neighbouring flagged words merge into one span. The weakest token in each span is kept.
Report each span with the alternatives the model was weighing
